name: GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated)
description: The GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) is a superlight 55 mm speed cube built for fast, accurate turning with simple, repeatable tuning. Piece magnets give precise layer “clicks,” MagLev removes spring friction for a low-drag glide, and core magnets (corner-to-core) add stability so layers realign quickly at high TPS—now with a UV coated exterior for durable, high-grip gloss at just ~64 g.
features: Fast, low-friction feel: MagLev elasticity eliminates spring noise and wear for quicker, smoother turns.
Stable alignment: Core magnets pull layers into place for cleaner execution and fewer lockups.
Light and agile: ~64 g superlight build reduces hand fatigue during long practice sessions.
UV coated grip: Glossy, hard-wearing finish provides confident hold and long-lasting shine.
Easy, repeatable setup: 72 tension/compression combinations let you dial in from soft and fast to firm and controlled—no guesswork.
Consistent feedback: 76 total magnets keep alignment crisp on every move.
